source: 15. What is ZXNAME0000XZ, and why must a hypothetical document generated by the model never be treated as evidence? [Advanced] ZXNAME0001XZ - Hypothetical Document Embeddings - asks a language model to generate a hypothetical document that would answer the query, embeds that generated text, and uses the embedding to retrieve nearby real documents. The generated document can contain false details; the ZXNAME0002XZ paper explicitly acknowledges that it is ’fake.’ Its role is to move the query into a representation that resembles relevant documents, not to supply factual evidence. The answer generator should still ground claims in retrieved corpus documents. This distinction is operationally important: if a system accidentally includes the hypothetical text as trusted context or cites it, the retrieval aid becomes a hallucinated source. ZXNAME0003XZ is most interesting when labeled relevance data are unavailable and zero-shot dense retrieval is weak, but its benefits are workload-dependent and it adds an ZXNAME0004XZ call before retrieval. [10]
zh: 15. 什么是 ZXNAME0000XZ，为什么模型生成的假设文档不能被视为证据？ [高级] ZXNAME0001XZ - 假设文档嵌入 - 要求语言模型生成一个假设文档来回答查询，嵌入生成的文本，并使用嵌入来检索附近的真实文档。生成的文档可能包含虚假详细信息； ZXNAME0002XZ 论文明确承认它是“假的”。它的作用是将查询转移到类似于相关文档的表示中，而不是提供事实证据。答案生成器仍应在检索到的语料库文档中论证声明。这种区别在操作上很重要：如果系统意外地将假设文本包含为可信上下文或引用它，检索辅助工具就会成为幻觉来源。当标记的相关性数据不可用且零样本密集检索较弱时，ZXNAME0003XZ 最有趣，但它的好处取决于工作负载，并且它在检索之前添加了 ZXNAME0004XZ 调用。 [10]
